script.base: Dallas is a 4-point favorite with a 23.8 implied total, so the base flow is a one-score game Dallas leads late but does not blow open. Javonte Williams (42 carries, 148 yards in weeks 4-6) gets the clock-killing carries. Dak still has to throw to get to 23.8, with CeeDee Lamb (44 targets) and George Pickens (27 targets, 278 yards) as the downfield pair. Philly's 19.8 implied total, with DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks out and Saquon Barkley questionable, points to a pass-leaning dog: short and intermediate throws to Dallas Goedert, Mikal Lemon and Darius Cooper rather than a Pierce/Bigsby/Shipley grind (Pierce 23 carries for 49 yards, 2.1 YPC).
script.flip1: Dallas jumps ahead early and runs the clock. Williams's carries rise, Dak's attempts stall, and Pickens/Lamb yardage unders hit the way a lead-and-grind script kills QB and WR overs. Philly then abandons the run, so Goedert's targets can still rise even while Pickens dies.
script.flip2: Barkley plays through the hamstring, Landon Dickerson (knee, questionable) holds up, and Philly controls the clock, or uncharted weather drags a 43.5 total into a teens slog. Both receiving overs die, and Dallas's late run script is the only thing that could push Williams toward 64.5 against a Philly run defense allowing 4.10 YPC.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both overs lost. Pickens finished in the 40s because Shelton's absence brought pressure, Philly did not need to blitz, and Dallas led by 10 at half so Williams (not Pickens) closed the game; the 130-yard outlier was the trap and the market was right to leave 64.5 at a coin flip. Goedert finished under 30 because the vacated Smith and Wicks targets went to Lemon and Cooper, the 4-yard dud was the real floor, Dickerson's knee cut the drive count, and 38 middle attempts were not a stable bleed. Barkley also played and Philly never had to live in the pass game.
slip_story: One story only: a competitive 23.8-19.8 pass game, not a Dallas clock-grind and not a total under. Pickens over and Goedert over can win together if both teams throw. Do not add Williams rush over, a game under, or any TD. Flournoy over 34.5 is the same-script alternate if Shelton is confirmed as a starting tackle, but the median gap is only about 4 yards, so he stays off the slip. No bet is placed.
